title: Ryan NDE 23005
content: I fainted then saw what was the past present and future which were all true and came true. Then I was whisked away to this white room. There were no lights that were making this light. But I felt whieghtless and nothing could hurt me, I was at peace and there was this big white door. It had to be bigger then 20 feet. I think the door opened and even more white light poured in. Then this man came and he was so pure good and u could not look at him to long because it hurt. Then he told me it is not ur time ryan. Then I woke up and started breathing.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No Accident. I was holding my breath and did not know I would faint or pass out and go into cardiac arrest
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Life review | Vision of the future | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I was in white cloths and they were nothing spiecal but I was dressed in white
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: 101% but not of the reality world
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning It felt as if I was gone for like 1-2 when it was only 5 to 10 min
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: Booming voice of a man and the people in my past and the people in my future but booming voice was not any one I knew
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes White room white door and white blinding man
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Uncertain He said Ryan its not ur time yet
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Peaceful and calm little scared but not much I just knew I was safe
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I was whisked away by some force to see the future past and present
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future I saw like an hour into the future
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion
